* add native Morphe settings row ([7a6ac24](https://github.com/ilikeadofai/vocacolle-morphe-patches/commit/7a6ac24c3b5bbe869d2710ea8b62788435687fbe))
* harden network and cache runtime safety ([8c0d133](https://github.com/ilikeadofai/vocacolle-morphe-patches/commit/8c0d133f54c84055ee1d5411cb3537805fb7575f))

### ✨ New Features

* complete VocaColle Morphe v1.1 ([23fa3f9](https://github.com/ilikeadofai/vocacolle-morphe-patches/commit/23fa3f9051177f747f4c250101cf86071f6ef052))

patches.name: Customize VocaColle branding
patches.description: Optionally changes the launcher name and icon while preserving the original Japanese branding by default.

options.description: Launcher name. Keep ボカコレ to preserve the original Japanese name.
Path to a square PNG. Leave empty to preserve the original icon.

patches.name: English UI
patches.description: Adds complete English static, hardcoded, and server-provided UI localization.

patches.name: Korean UI
patches.description: Adds complete Korean static, hardcoded, and server-provided UI localization.

patches.name: VocaColle Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds display-language, cache, diagnostic, and patch-version controls to native Morphe settings.

patches.name: VocaColle compatibility probe
patches.description: Verifies that VocaColle 7.40.0 can be decoded, rebuilt, and signed without changing app behavior.
